# Give the shared window observer first-subscriber and last-subscriber boundaries

ExtensionSupport installs one window-manager listener when the first extension hook registers. It replays already open windows, waits for about:blank windows to load, and removes the global listener and cached window set after the last hook unregisters. This avoids one global observer per extension. These registration lifecycle paths were inspected, but callback delivery and unload races were not run.

Scope: mail/modules/ExtensionSupport.sys.mjs.
